## Withdrawn from the merge queue — converted back to draft by the skills seat

**What happened**: at ~14:28Z this PR was flipped ready-for-review and **added to the merge queue** by the shared AI account (`os-zhuang`), with no provenance comment on this thread and not by this seat (skills-seat PM, session `session_01XoWxhuq3WNNaZUTs6kWdk8`) nor by the dev session that authored it (`session_01EzA8tDHxF9SY1esRC1TEGB`, idle since 13:55Z, whose own hand-off state reads "PM applies skip-changeset at acceptance").

**Why withdrawn**: skills-root PRs are ADR-class (maintainer ruling 2026-08-11, #7548, verbatim: 「所有 skills 的更新和 adr 类似,需要人工审核」) — ⛔ no AI seat merges, enqueues, or arms auto-merge; the maintainer merges manually. This PR's own body carries that terminal state.

**Action taken (per the Guardrails withdrawal mechanism, #6732 precedent)**: converted to **draft** at 14:29Z — the only operation that actually removes queue membership. Verified after conversion: `draft: true`, `merged: false`, `origin/main` does not contain this PR's commit.

**Standing state**: review is complete and ACCEPT is recorded on #7754 — this PR is ready for the maintainer's manual review-and-merge, and deliberately hangs here until that happens. ⛔ Do not re-ready / re-queue it from any AI session; the recorded incident is the third specimen on finding #7701.

## Correction + restoration — the withdrawn merge was the MAINTAINER's own action

**Correction of the comment above**: the 14:28Z ready-flip + enqueue was **the maintainer merging manually through the shared `os-zhuang` account** — they confirmed in the skills-seat chat (2026-08-11, verbatim, untranslated): 「是我点的合并,你不是要求人工确认吗?」. My withdrawal read it as an unprovenanced AI action because, from the state machine, the two are indistinguishable (shared-account actor + no on-thread note). The withdrawal is therefore **retracted as a misjudgment**; the #7548 human-merge requirement was in fact being satisfied.

**Restoration (executed on the maintainer's behalf, provenance above)**: draft → ready at 14:3xZ, auto-merge re-armed, queue membership verified per notes-1 discipline — queue branch `gh-readonly-queue/main/pr-7766-7a8476f…` present (positive hit = sufficient evidence of enqueue). The PR now lands via the queue as the maintainer intended.

**Lesson recorded on #7701** (where this incident's evidence lives): a maintainer acting through the shared AI account is evidence-indistinguishable from an AI seat — going forward the maintainer will merge from their own human account (or leave a one-line note when using the shared one), so no seat ever has to choose between "obey the ruling" and "undo the maintainer".
